verdict.rationale: Brex's own docs describe a one-click action that books accruals across incomplete expenses, which is a native bulk action, but a narrow one. The developer docs also describe bulk-creating users and setting limits for many users, but only through the third-party Pipedream low-code platform, so that earns little credit. The APIs and MCP server are building blocks, not documented bulk endpoints. Missing for 10: documented native bulk endpoints or UI bulk actions across expenses/cards/users, bulk operations via the MCP server for AI use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
